prompt:
The section sections/size-guide-units.liquid renders a size table. Its markup carries state across loop iterations. current_unit starts as section.settings.default_unit. Each "unit_header" block changes current_unit to its own unit setting and resets the row counter. Each "size_row" block increments the counter and prints its measurements with the current unit. The first row after the start or after each unit header gets the class "is-first" when section.settings.highlight_first_row is on.

The {% schema %} block is wrong. Do not change the markup. Replace only the schema JSON so that it is exactly the following. Key order inside objects does not matter, but array order does.

Top level:
- name "Size guide"
- tag "section"
- class "size-guide-section"
- max_blocks 24

settings (in this order):
1. type "text", id "heading", label "Heading", default "Size guide".
2. type "select", id "default_unit", label "Default unit", default "cm", options in this order: {value "cm", label "Centimeters"}, {value "in", label "Inches"}.
3. type "checkbox", id "highlight_first_row", label "Highlight first row after each unit change", default true.

blocks (in this order):
1. type "unit_header", name "Unit header", limit 4. Its settings, in order:
   - select "unit", label "Unit", options in this order: {value "cm", label "Centimeters"}, {value "in", label "Inches"}, default "in". The default is inches because a header normally switches away from the section default.
   - text "caption", label "Caption", no default key at all.
2. type "size_row", name "Size row", no limit. Its settings, in order:
   - text "label", label "Size", default "M"
   - text "chest", label "Chest", no default
   - text "waist", label "Waist", no default

presets: exactly one preset, name "Size guide", with blocks in this order:
1. {"type":"size_row","settings":{"label":"S"}}
2. {"type":"size_row","settings":{"label":"M"}}
3. {"type":"unit_header"}, with no settings key
4. {"type":"size_row","settings":{"label":"L"}}

The schema must contain no other keys. Change only sections/size-guide-units.liquid. Do not suppress checks or hardcode case values. All input keys are present.
